title: Kill the local cmux-tui under two terminal tabs, retry the connection, and converge to the same workspace, tabs and terminals
preconditions: a fresh launch: one window, one workspace, one terminal tab, connected to the tag's own cmux-tui

allow_crashes.reason: drop-connection kills the tag's cmux-tui owner on purpose to drop the app's connection

steps.note: the launch's connection to the tag's cmux-tui is up
a second terminal tab, so two terminal hosts outlive the owner

expect.noReceiptReason: a killed process runs no action; the connection state the waitFor reads is the result

steps.note: SIGKILL of the cmux-tui owner (not its terminal hosts): the app sees the connection end and leaves connected

expect.noReceiptReason: debug.daemon retry is the recovery card's Retry Now, which runs no catalog action; the connection state the next step waits for is its result

steps.note: Retry Now: the app ensures a new owner and connects at once; a no-op when the app already reconnected by itself
the new owner adopted the terminal hosts and the app has a fresh snapshot
a mutation on the new connection reaches the new owner and comes back in its snapshot

invariants: after-reconnect has the workspace, the two terminal tabs and the focused pane of before-drop with the same public ids: the new owner adopted the hosts
no intent is pending at after-reconnect and the rollback and refusal counters did not move: no mutation was dropped without a refusal
the crashes facet counts exactly one daemon exit, at drop-connection, and no holder exit
rename-after-reconnect changes only the workspace's name
every mutation has one receipt or one typed error (I1)
teardown: quit the tagged app the run started
verify its debug socket is gone
untested: a mutation sent while disconnected: no barrier holds the disconnected state, so whether it lands before or after the reconnect is a race
a delayed (not dropped) connection: the app has no latency injection for its local daemon
the agent connection: the bench launch's mock agent pane has no connection to drop
the connection generation as the UI names it: topology.generation is volatile (schemas/oracle/README.md, Counters of commits)
